name: metadata-dataset-service
description: Read API over the dataset records of the database it is installed in (records in the std_dataset shape of the EUFGIS data dictionary): the overview rows the dataset pages list, one record by code, the collections summary, the datasets that hold a term. One setting: the name of the dataset collection.
author: Milko Škofič

datasetCollection.description: The collection of this database that holds the dataset records, every one in the std_dataset shape. GeoService: Dataset; metadata: dataset. The service reads it and never writes it; setup and teardown never touch it.
